_doc: Named read-only queries a gate declaration may reference by query_id (check_kind db_max / incident_absent / sql_threshold). A declaration can never carry SQL. Each query returns ONE row with ONE column named value (a timestamp for db_max, a number otherwise). Run under a 2 s statement_timeout in a read-only transaction.

open_alert_incidents.sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM alert_incidents WHERE resolved_at IS NULL

alert_incidents_newest_seen.sql: SELECT max(first_seen_at) AS value FROM alert_incidents
